description: This file provides a singleton helper class for managing shared preferences in a Flutter app. It wraps the SharedPreferences package with methods for initializing, reading, writing, and clearing preferences, encapsulating access to persistent key-value storage.

classes.name: PreferenceHelper
classes.description: Singleton class that simplifies access to shared preferences by providing static methods for initialization, reading, writing, and clearing key-value data.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper._
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation, enforcing singleton pattern.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.init
methods.description: Initializes the SharedPreferences instance; must be called before any other read/write.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.writeInt
methods.description: Writes an integer value to preferences with the specified key.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.writeBool
methods.description: Writes a boolean value to preferences with the specified key.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.writeString
methods.description: Writes a string value to preferences with the specified key.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer from preferences, defaulting to 0 if not set.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string from preferences, defaulting to 'en' if not set.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.getBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean from preferences, defaulting to true unless specified otherwise.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.getLoginBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean indicating login status, defaulting to false.

methods.name: PreferenceHelper.clear
methods.description: Clears all preferences; useful for logout functionality.
